text:
maria_cs: Heads-up: Quetzal Labs hitting a burst of 429s during SDK ramp after we switched them to dedicated routing. Repro at ~120rps from their canary. Logs show 'quota_exceeded' in handshake. Curl trace attached.

maria_cs: ```
> curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_..." -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
* Connected to api.redwood.ai
< HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-window: 60000
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 1887654380
{"error":{"code":"quota_exceeded","message":"client rate window exceeded"}}
```

tim_onboard: @maria_cs can you paste the customer's API key id (not full key) and the project id? need to check quota plan and if they were moved to dedicated pool.

maria_cs: key id = key_qtz_prod_12, project = quetzal-main. They were on free credits then bumped to reserved commit yesterday.

raj_infra: :thinking: If x-rate-limit-window is 60000 that's 60s window. Remaining=0 at 120rps seems odd unless per-client window is lower or proxy is double-counting. Are they using the node SDK with connection pooling?

lisa_sdk: They said they used official node SDK 1.4.2 with keepAlive true. We've seen an issue where older SDKs open multiple sockets per worker causing token fanout. Can you ask for their worker count?

maria_cs: They reported a Kubernetes job with 8 replicas, each sending 15rps bursts. Also using a sidecar proxy for egress (envoy) according to their infra team.

raj_infra: Sidecar could be rewriting headers so our per-key hashing groups them incorrectly. @lisa_sdk can you check if our rate limiter keys include upstream IP or connection id? We should rely only on API key id.

lisa_sdk: Checked infra doc: limiter key = api_key_id + route. No IP. But envoy injecting x-forwarded-for won't matter. I'm more suspicious of their proxy doing retries on 429 leading to feedback loop.

maria_cs: They did confirm client-side retry middleware on 429 with exponential backoff starting at 100ms — may be too aggressive. I asked them to disable retries for now.

tim_onboard: Quick mitigation steps: 1) ask them to disable client-side 429 retries, 2) enable burst-protection on our side (we can increase per-key temporary burst allowance for key_qtz_prod_12), 3) we'll check audit to see if they were temporarily assigned to a smaller shard.

raj_infra: I created a transient policy: increase burst quota to +50% for key_qtz_prod_12 for 10m. Deploy-bot will apply.

deploy-bot: Policy update queued: increase-burst key=key_qtz_prod_12 delta=+50% ttl=600s — deployed to edge-rlimit modules (id: deploy_1887654430)

maria_cs: Customer disabled retries, rerunning the canary now.

maria_cs: Update: traffic resumed, 429s dropped to baseline. They're happy. We'll follow up to recommend SDK upgrade and a config doc about retries + burst windows.

lisa_sdk: filing a small note in SDK changelog to highlight default retry behavior and recommended backoffs.

tim_onboard: Great. Maria, please capture in CSM notes and mark as onboarding-risk resolved. Add renewal flag cleared.

maria_cs: Done. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
